scope: all 84 sentences of batch-0102/0103, not only the 30 sampled

regenerated.komme ind på: Audit: every sentence of the previous family broke V2 ("I sin artikel kom ind på journalisten emnet"). Start each main clause with its subject: "Journalisten kom ind på emnet i sin artikel."
regenerated.uden for (weather-nature): Audit: "slå teltet op uden for skovgrænsen" was an unnatural collocation. Use plain everyday settings where "uden for" is natural (uden for byen, uden for huset, uden for vinduet) with weather content.

translation_corrections.why: ven is a (male) friend; подруга is veninde

regenerated.uden for (weather-nature): Audit: "uden for" must be the preposition with its complement right after it (uden for byen, uden for huset, uden for vinduet); "vi stod uden for." is the adverb, spelled udenfor. Previous attempts also used an unnatural collocation (uden for skovgrænsen).
